Header: Chaetocnema spp Sinhala- Pimi-kurumina; Tamil-ilaimarakkarikalil thellu vandu

Prevention: Establish about 1-2 m high physical barrier around the field, before planting
Maintain a fertile soil by adding compost or organic manure.
In severe infestations, completely prune vegetative parts after harvest and destroy crop residues
Monitoring: Focus on the young plants which are much more sensitive to flea beetle feeding than the mature crop
Look for small holes on leaves
Observe flea beetles (black coloured small insects of about 1 mm, with large hind legs and short antenna) can be seen mostly underside of leaves
Direct Control: Use sweep net to catch flea beetles by swiftly moving on the crop canopy
Annona seeds in a litre of water for 24 hours.
Drain and add another litre of water and mix with 06 g of soap.
Spray weekly, preferably in the evening
Restrictions: Always wear personal protective equipment while handling pesticides.
MOA insecticides to maximum of 2 applications per season
Rate of dilution- 5 g/16 lit. of water.
Systemic insecticide with contact/ stomach action.
Apply only once per cropping cycle
